routeAssumptions.anchors: Static id and named-anchor attributes only; dynamically created anchors are not checked.
routeAssumptions.css: CSS url() and quoted @import are heuristic; dynamically generated CSS, escaped syntax and conditional loading are not evaluated. Unquoted root URLs are not rewritten by the Pages build.
routeAssumptions.evidence: Tokens, element counts and controller script references identified by filename are static evidence only; empty results do not mean absence, and none establish runtime behavior or complete dependencies.
routeAssumptions.external: All absolute and protocol-relative URLs, including same-site hostnames, are excluded from validation and redacted; host equivalence is not inferred.
routeAssumptions.local: Node server: / maps to main.html; directory paths are not served.
routeAssumptions.pages: Project base /datalab/; root-relative HTML attribute URLs modeled after build-pages.mjs; directories map to index.html.
routeAssumptions.routes: Duplicate checks cover canonical source-derived URLs; index aliases are implicit and runtime redirects are not verified.
routeAssumptions.srcset: Static candidates only; complex data URI forms may need manual review.

scope: Classification only; reuses catalog IDs and mapping. No merge, registry, storage or route mutation.
